kai: quick note  onboarding "albatross-7b" (community -> rlib) shows weird top-k token reorder on long chats after int4 conversion. short convs OK.

ops-bot: eval/job/5005005000 finished: task=chat_consistency, metric=exact_token_seq, float=0.987, int4=0.742, delta=-0.245 :warning:

sasha: did converter preserve rotary/vocab metadata? some Mistral->Gemma fan ckpts have alternate rope/head ordering.

maria: converter log: rotary_meta present but we flattened headmap to single_scale=1.0. tokenizer manifest shows casefold=true but ckpt tokenizer keeps case. also found ZWJ handling differences.

jin: can you paste a minimal repro and one failing example? curious if tokenization or rotary/headmap is dominant.

kai: repro snippet:```python
from redwood_eval import load_model, generate
m = load_model('redwood/albatross-7b-int4')
ctx = "User: Explain the merge of A and B in the system.\nAssistant:"
out = generate(m, ctx, max_new_tokens=512)
print(out)
# observed: float returns expected bullet list, int4 returns repeated fragments and early eos
```

sasha: classic signs of head-order mismatch + quant rounding in kv cache. headwise rotary scale or swapped Q/K projection layout can cause contextual misalignment.

maria: i ran token diff: only 0.9% token mismatches due to case and ZWJ. when forcing converter to use ckpt tokenizer + preserving per-head rotary array in manifest, int4 quality still low (~0.78). toggling runtime to apply per-head rotary scale on kv-write jumps to ~0.86.

jin: what about proj-order? some Gemma->Qwen conversions swap proj dim ordering. try running float ckpt with our runtime but with proj-order remapped; if float breaks similarly it's converter-layout problem.

kai: good call. i ran float+proj_remap and it reproduces the pattern (0.985->0.75). so we have two orthogonal issues: proj-order mismatch and per-head rotary/kv rounding.

sasha: plan: 1) add converter check that inspects ckpt q/k/proj layout and emits a lint if nonstandard 2) preserve per-head rotary arrays in manifest and make runtime auto-enable kv-rescale-on-write 3) add converter flag --tokenizer=ckpt to reduce normalization diffs for onboarding 4) infra: add warmup-stable quant mode for first N tokens.

maria: i'll prototype proj-remap detection (heuristic: inspect q/k weight shapes and head-axis labels) and a small shim to remap proj dims at load-time if detected. jin will add unit test.

ops-bot: job/5005005065 started: smoke-int4+proj-remap+kv-rescale subset=250
\kjin: if smoke recovers >0.9 we'll wire onboarding autofixes; otherwise revert to keeping stable-kernel fallback for longctx. keeping this thread as canonical triage for albatross-onboard.
